# `^B7` – PDF417 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/comparisons/README.md)


Print a PDF417 two-dimensional stacked barcode capable of encoding over 1000 characters.

Reference parameters: **o, h, s, c, r, t**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 79](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
